name: Payment Receipt Generator
title: Payment Receipt Generator Pakistan (Free, PDF)
description: Make a payment receipt with amount in figures and words, payment mode, invoice reference and balance due. Free, prints to PDF, nothing is uploaded.
lead: Record who paid, how much, how and for what, and print a receipt with the remaining balance.
intro: A receipt is proof that money was received. It protects both sides. This tool writes the amount in figures and words and can show what is still due.
how: Enter who paid, the amount, the mode (cash, bank, cheque, online) and what it was for.
Add the invoice number it is against.
Enter the total due to show the balance after this payment.
example: Total due Rs. 85,000. Received Rs. 50,000. Balance after this payment: Rs. 35,000.
mistakes: Not writing the invoice number it clears.
Writing the amount in figures only.
Not noting the cheque or transaction number.

faq.q: Is this receipt a tax document?
faq.a: No. It records a payment. It is not a sales tax invoice.

faq.q: Can I show a part payment?
faq.a: Yes. Enter the total due and the amount received, and the balance is shown.
No. Print or download it. Keep your own copy.

disclaimer: This tool only lays out the details you type. It does not file anything with FBR or any authority, and it is not legal or tax advice.
